```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Interactions

  Scenario: Admin can edit labs/pharmacy details (update/delete)
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin navigates to the labs/pharmacy management page
    And the admin selects a lab/pharmacy to edit
    And the admin updates the details
    Then the lab/pharmacy details should be updated in the system
    And the admin should receive a confirmation message

    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin navigates to the labs/pharmacy management page
    And the admin selects a lab/pharmacy to delete
    And the admin confirms the deletion
    Then the lab/pharmacy should be deleted from the system
    And the admin should receive a confirmation message

  Scenario: Patient can register
    Given the patient is on the registration page
    When the patient enters their details (name, email, password)
    And the patient submits the registration form
    Then the patient should receive a confirmation message
    And the patient's details should be stored in the system

  Scenario: Patient can update profile
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to the profile page
    And the patient updates their details (name, email, password)
    And the patient submits the update form
    Then the patient's details should be updated in the system
    And the patient should receive a confirmation message

  Scenario: Patient can make appointments and submit online consultation requests
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to the appointment page
    And the patient selects a doctor and a time slot
    And the patient submits the appointment request
    Then the appointment should be scheduled in the system
    And the doctor should receive a notification

    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to the consultation page
    And the patient submits an online consultation request
    Then the consultation request should be submitted in the system
    And the doctor should receive a notification

  Scenario: Patient can view and generate prescription reports and invoices
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to the prescriptions page
    And the patient selects a prescription
    Then the prescription report should be displayed
    And the patient should be able to download the report

    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient navigates to the invoices page
    And the patient selects an invoice
    Then the invoice should be displayed
    And the patient should be able to download the invoice

  Scenario: Doctor can provide consultation
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor receives a consultation request
    And the doctor accepts the request
    Then the consultation session should be started
    And the doctor should be able to communicate with the patient

  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe medicine
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor receives a consultation request
    And the doctor accepts the request
    And the doctor prescribes medicine
    And the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the prescription should be stored in the system
    And the patient should receive a notification

  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor receives a consultation request
    And the doctor accepts the request
    And the doctor prescribes a lab test
    And the doctor submits the lab test request
    Then the lab test request should be stored in the system
    And the patient should receive a notification
```
